epilog.title: Epilog
epilog.copy: We used StyleGAN2-ada-pytorch, an approach for training generative adversarial networks developed by NvLabs (NVIDIA). Our aim was to explore the whole pipeline in order to get familiar with the use of styleGAN2 as a tool for creative processes. Testing pre-trained models, creating a dataset from curated images, training a dataset, generating images from our trained dataset. In order to explore ways to enhance the visual quality of our results, we upscaled them again with the help of neural networks. For the batch- processig and upscaling of images, we adapted ESRGAN for our purposes.
